name: clustre-fast
reference: Fischer, Gottesbüren et al. CluStRE: Streaming Graph Clustering with Multi-Stage Refinement. 2025. (light mode: one-pass streaming). Shares one build with clustre-strong under external/clustre.

one_pass_algorithm.doc: Streaming objective function. Fixed to modularity, the objective this survey optimises; set-only.

cluster_fraction.doc: Caps initial clusters at cluster_fraction*n. 0 leaves CluStRE's default (5M cap), i.e. uncapped for our graphs. A capacity limit, not a tuned knob; set-only. Light mode is otherwise parameter-free, so Protocol A and B coincide.
